questions.q: A particle moves in a straight line with acceleration a(t) = 6t - 4. If its initial velocity at t = 0 is 3 m/s, find its velocity at t = 3 seconds.
The displacement of a particle is given by s(t) = t³ - 6t² + 9t meters. Find the total distance traveled by the particle in the time interval from t = 0 to t = 4 seconds.
A ball is projected upwards from ground level with an initial velocity of 20 m/s. Taking g = 10 m/s², find the maximum height reached by the ball.
A projectile is launched from ground level with a speed of 28 m/s at an angle of 30° to the horizontal. Find its time of flight (taking g = 9.8 m/s²).
For a projectile launched with speed u at an angle α to the horizontal, what is the expression for the horizontal range R on level ground?
A car accelerates uniformly from rest to a speed of 25 m/s over a distance of 100 meters. Find the acceleration of the car.
A particle is projected horizontally at 15 m/s from the top of a tower 45 meters high. Find the time taken to hit the ground (g = 10 m/s²).
A stone is dropped from rest down a well and hits the water after 2.5 seconds. Find the depth of the well (g = 9.8 m/s²).
A particle moves in a straight line such that its velocity v is given by v = 4t - t². Find the maximum displacement from the origin for t ≥ 0.
A projectile has an initial speed of 50 m/s and reaches a maximum height of 45 meters. Find the angle of projection α (g = 10 m/s²).
A particle moves with deceleration proportional to its velocity, so that dv/dt = -kv. If its initial velocity is u and velocity at time t is u/2, find the time taken.
A ball is thrown with speed 20 m/s at an angle of 45° above the horizontal. Find its speed at the highest point of its trajectory.
A particle travels in a straight line with acceleration a = 4 - 2t. If s = 0 when t = 0 and s = 10 when t = 3, what is s at t = 3?
A bullet penetrates a wooden block of thickness 10 cm, entering at 400 m/s and emerging at 100 m/s. Assuming constant deceleration, find the time spent inside the block.
Find the Cartesian equation of the trajectory of a projectile launched with speed u at angle α: y = x tan(α) - (gx²) / (2u² cos²(α)). If u = 20 m/s, α = 30°, find y when x = 10 meters (g = 10).

Two particles A and B start from the same point moving in the same direction. Particle A moves with constant velocity 10 m/s, while B starts from rest with constant acceleration 2 m/s². When do they meet again?
A particle is projected from a point on level ground with speed 30 m/s at an angle of 60° to the horizontal. Find its velocity vector after 2 seconds (g = 10 m/s²).
A lift ascends with constant acceleration 1.5 m/s². A bolt drops from the ceiling of the lift, which is 3 meters high. Find the time taken for the bolt to hit the floor (g = 9.8 m/s²).
The displacement of a particle moving in a plane is given by r = [3t², 4t³ - t]. Find the magnitude of its acceleration vector at t = 1 second.
A particle is projected horizontally from a point h meters above the ground with speed u. It hits the ground at a distance R from the base. If h = 20 meters and R = 40 meters, find u (g = 10 m/s²).
A particle moves along a line with velocity v = 3t² - 12t + 9. Find the total distance traveled in the interval [0, 4].
A ball is thrown vertically downwards from a height of 50 meters with an initial speed of 5 m/s. Find the speed with which it hits the ground (g = 10 m/s²).
A projectile is projected with speed u at angle α. At what angle α is the maximum height equal to the horizontal range divided by 4?
A particle is projected from ground level and passes through a point (x, y) = (10, 10) meters with an angle of 45°. What was the initial speed u (g = 10)?
A train slows down uniformly from 30 m/s to rest over a distance of 250 meters. Find the time taken.
A particle moves with acceleration a = -9.8 - 0.1v². Which differential equation represents its velocity with respect to displacement s?
A projectile is launched from the top of a cliff 50 meters high with speed 20 m/s horizontally. Find its impact speed with the sea below (g = 9.8 m/s²).
A particle's position is given by x = sin(2t) and y = cos(2t). Describe its path.
a: Circle of radius 1 centered at origin

questions.q: A particle is projected up a plane inclined at 30° to the horizontal, with initial velocity 20 m/s straight up the line of greatest slope. Find the time before it comes to instantaneous rest on the plane (g = 9.8).
If the range of a projectile on a horizontal plane is 100 meters, find the maximum height reached if projected at an optimal angle for maximum range.
A particle moves in a straight line with simple harmonic motion characterized by acceleration a = -9x. Find its period of oscillation T.
A body is projected with speed u at angle α. At what time t is the velocity vector perpendicular to the initial velocity vector?
A particle is dropped from a height H. At the same instant, another particle is projected upwards with speed u from the ground. They collide at height H/2. Find u in terms of H and g.
A stone is thrown horizontally with speed 10 m/s from a cliff. After what time is its velocity vector inclined at 45° to the horizontal (g = 10)?
A particle moves such that v² = 4(9 - x²). Find its maximum acceleration magnitude.
A shell is fired from a gun with muzzle velocity 200 m/s at an elevation of 30°. Find the horizontal distance traveled before hitting a target at the same horizontal level (g = 9.8).
A particle moves in a straight line with deceleration a = -v³. If initial velocity is 1, find its velocity at t = 1.
A particle is projected from the origin with velocity [12, 16] m/s. Find the time it takes to reach its maximum height (g = 10).

A ball is projected horizontally from a height with speed u. If its speed upon hitting the ground is twice its initial speed u, find the angle its trajectory makes with the vertical just before impact.
A particle moves with simple harmonic motion between x = -5 and x = 5 with period 4 seconds. Find its maximum speed.
